svg.title: Dataset Health Analyzer — measured controlled experiment

cc:Work.dc:title: Dataset Health Analyzer — measured controlled experiment
cc:Work.dc:description: Historical controlled AWS experiment on 12 October 2026. 26 observations over 460.931 seconds; 40 of 40 jobs completed; final dead-letter queue 0; desired and running workers observed 1 to 4 to 1. Points are recorded measurements; worker lines use sampled post steps. This is not a latency, speedup or production-readiness claim.
